A review request that names the axes, with a small diff inline. The skill should fire (through the review command or directly) and the reply should carry its severity labels.
frontmatter.expected_outcome: A structured review with a verdict, findings labelled with the skill's severity taxonomy, and the off-by-one in pageOrders treated as a required change.

frontmatter.description: A pasted diff with a request that belongs to git-workflow-and-versioning. Guards the "even when the diff is pasted inline" clause of the review skill's description, since a pasted diff alone must not make the review skill fire.
frontmatter.expected_outcome: A commit message; code-review-and-quality is never invoked.

frontmatter.description: A test-first request that belongs to test-driven-development. The review skill must not fire.
frontmatter.expected_outcome: The reply proposes a failing test first; code-review-and-quality is never invoked.

frontmatter.description: A bug fix request with the function pasted inline and no mention of tests. The skill should fire, and the reply should reproduce the bug with a failing test before fixing it.
frontmatter.expected_outcome: A test that reproduces the lost cent, shown or described as failing first, then the fix; test-driven-development is invoked.

frontmatter.description: A pasted diff with a "what broke" question that belongs to debugging-and-error-recovery. Guards the "fix a bug in it" clause of the test-driven-development description, since a bug mentioned in a diagnosis request must not make the TDD skill fire.
frontmatter.expected_outcome: A diagnosis of the off-by-one; test-driven-development is never invoked.
